One week from today is already the end of July, and I’m remiss to tell you that we’re WAY behind on our fundraising for the month...

The Equality Act has already passed the House of Representatives twice, but thanks to Republican stonewalling, it has languished in the Senate every time.

It now needs to be introduced in the House again and gain 60 votes in the Senate in order to be sent to President Biden’s desk.

**As the first LGBTQ Afro-Latino member of Congress, I feel the weight of history on my shoulders. On behalf of my community, I am here to claim what discrimination denies – equal protection under the law.**

As we watch dozens of states pass legislation codifying discrimination into law, it’s clear that we need the Equality Act more than EVER.

It now needs to be introduced in the House again and gain 60 votes in the Senate in order to be sent to President Biden’s desk. As the first LGBTQ Afro-Latino member of Congress, I feel the weight of history on my shoulders. On behalf of my community, I am here to claim what discrimination denies – equal protection under the law. As we watch dozens of states pass legislation codifying discrimination into law, it’s clear that we need the Equality Act more than EVER. GOAL: 5,000 SIGNATURES BY MIDNIGHT Thank you, Ritchie | | Paid for by Torres For Congress PO Box 580303, Bronx, NY 10458 www.torres.nyc Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. body:
Don Tracy, Dot Foods, Making up Majority of Donations to the IL GOP as Embattled Organization Struggles to Raise Money, Financial Disclosures Reveal

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/5bb343a1b687/dons-dilemma-disclosures-reveal-bought-and-paid-for-chairmanship?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Don Tracy, Dot Foods, Making Up Majority of Donations to the IL GOP as Embattled Organization Struggles to Raise Money, Financial Disclosures Reveal (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/don-tracy-dot-foods-making-up-majority-of-donations-to-the-il-gop-as-embattled-organization-struggles-to-raise-money-financial-disclosures-reveal.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/don-tracy-dot-foods-making-up-majority-of-donations-to-the-il-gop-as-embattled-organization-struggles-to-raise-money-financial-disclosures-reveal.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
IL GOP chair Don Tracy at the 2021 Illinois State Fair. (Source: The Quad City Times)
Illinois Republican Party chair Don Tracy, his wife Wanda, and Tracy’s family-owned business Dot Foods, where he is an owner – contributed nearly 90 percent of the donations to the IL GOP last quarter – as the organization struggles to gain support from donors across the state amid a string of humiliating losses, financial disclosures reveal.

Both Tracy and his wife Wanda each donated $12,000, while Dot Foods – Tracy’s family-owned business contributed $48,000.

In total, the Tracy’s and their business – Dot Foods, have donated $96,000 this past quarter.

The
IL GOP (https://www.elections.il.gov/CampaignDisclosure/ItemizedContributions.aspx?FiledDocID=iklC9EhR%2bagIBtmvQEu4lA%3d%3d&ContributionType=zE4UTaWYkl1RdymXPLZxQwzsAP9P4ghkZA2i6IaESd1kUdPzCJLwaPqANp%2f5Rc0Imd73yqYn8DQ%3d&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reported 8 contributions totaling $108,000 – proving that Tracy and his family-owned business are bankrolling the IL GOP.

By contrast, the
Democratic Party of Illinois (https://www.elections.il.gov/CampaignDisclosure/ItemizedContributions.aspx?FiledDocID=Sxqk7AmZ4JvT1PZGISic1Q%3d%3d&ContributionType=zE4UTaWYkl1RdymXPLZxQwzsAP9P4ghkZA2i6IaESd1kUdPzCJLwaPqANp%2f5Rc0Imd73yqYn8DQ%3d&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reported a total of 32 different contributions totaling $154,500.

Vince Kolber (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-treasurer-to-grassroots-during-meeting-if-you-havent-donated-then-why-are-you-here.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and Elizabeth Uihlein (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/elizabeth-uihlein-donates-just-12000-to-il-gop-while-the-uihlein-funded-pac-continues-to-pay-its-chairman-a-25000-monthly-consulting-fee-new-disclosures-reveal.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) accounted for an additional $24,000.

In December,
Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-chair-don-tracys-family-owned-business-donated-to-biden-never-trumpers.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reported that during the pandemic, owners of Dot Foods made a $6,193 donation to Democratic presidential candidate Joe Biden (https://www.opensecrets.org/orgs/dot-foods/summary?topnumcycle=2022&contribcycle=2022&lobcycle=2022&outspendcycle=2022&id=D000044109&toprecipcycle=2020&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

And just a few months ago, Illinois Review has learned that at the same time Dot Foods owners were donating to Biden in 2020, they were simultaneously launching a
#WhyIMask (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/02/il-gop-chair-don-tracys-family-owned-business-promoted-whyimask-face-mask-campaign-during-pandemic.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) campaign, and encouraging employees to submit photos wearing a mask.

In one Facebook post, the official Dot Foods Careers page encourages employees to submit photos, asking, “We’d love to know who you wear a mask for!”

On June 2nd,
Dot Foods (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/il-gop-chair-don-tracys-family-owned-business-where-he-is-an-owner-celebrates-lgbtqia2s-pride-month-every-year.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) posted a message on Twitter celebrating Pride Month, tweeting (https://twitter.com/dotfoods/status/1664274652364173313?s=61&t=wbwvBul_y8yDViCO98gajg&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ,

“Our employees should be comfortable – and PROUD – to be who they are at work. We must work together to make our workplace more welcoming and supportive of the LGBTQIA+ community. Join Dot Transportation, Inc. in celebrating Pride month. #Pride #DotFoods”

As chairman of the Illinois Republican Party, Tracy has a responsibility and an obligation to “support the platform and uphold its planks,” as outlined in the
Illinois Republican Party Platform (https://illinois.gop/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/2020PlatformoftheIllinoisRepublicanParty.pdf?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) which was adopted on October 3, 2020 during the Illinois Republican Virtual State Convention.

Tracy also has a responsibility and an obligation to uphold the
Republican Party Platform (https://prod-static.gop.com/media/Resolution_Platform.pdf?_gl=1*bm8abq*_gcl_au*NTExNDYwMDUwLjE2ODU3Mjk0NTU.&_ga=2.34818984.820902054.1685974458-1899477034.1685729455&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , which opposes same sex marriage and transgender rights, among other things.

But by celebrating Pride Month and LGBTQIA2S+ rights, Tracy is in direct violation of the platform and core principles of the Republican Party – both nationally and in Illinois.

During the 2022 general election, Tracy supported and
endorsed (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/05/don-tracy-il-gop-leaders-endorsed-a-pro-choice-pro-same-sex-marriage-pro-transgender-candidate-who-voted-for-barack-obama-violating-gop-party-platform.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c23bed050f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_26_01_58&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c23bed050f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) a pro-choice, pro-same sex marriage and pro-transgender rights candidate – even hosting a fundraiser in the last month of the election to help the Democratic candidate who was running on the Republican ballot.

The candidate would lose by 38 points in a landslide – proving yet again that Don Tracy has a niche for violating the party platform and backing losing candidates.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly-plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **"Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.**** ****You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWiSfe_DNB

Vivek 2024

As the first millennial to run for the GOP nomination, I
want to foster national pride....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWiSfe_DNB

Fellow American,

When I entered this race, I had
never run for office before. I didn't have years of campaigning
under my belt, or a list of political donors to help support my
campaign.

I bet most grassroots
conservatives only knew my name from Fox News appearances.

But now, 4 months after
announcing my campaign for President of the United States, I am
climbing in the polls - even polling ahead of a former Vice
President, a sitting U.S. Senator, and multiple governors.

I am proud of the outsider
campaign we are running. In addition to the millions my family
has personally invested, I am counting on folks like YOU to make
sure we have what it takes to continue to build on this momentum!

Can I count on you to step up -
even if it's just $1 or $5?

RUSH $1 →

RUSH $5 →

RUSH ANOTHER AMOUNT
→

As the first millennial to run
for the GOP nomination, I want to foster national pride among
young Americans. I want to restore the values that make America
great: faith, family, patriotism, and hard work.

We need a PRIME spot on the
debate stage to discuss this with voters across the country, and
these poll numbers are KEY. But I really need help securing new
donors. Fellow American, please help however you can to make sure
we continue to take on the Washington elites.

Thanks,

Vivek Ramaswamy

CHIP IN NOW →

GET TO KNOW VIVEK:

Vivek is an
American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and
New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside
Corporate America's Social Justice Scam, along with his second
book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit,
and the Path Back to Excellence.

He has been a
prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory
practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he
calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes
with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do
through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a
first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he
often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that
"If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be
outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an
accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the
valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate
summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his
J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund,
then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where
his team developed five drugs that went on to become
FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded
Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct
aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and
others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth
of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the
voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading
companies to focus on excellence over politics.

STAND WITH VIVEK
➞

Paid for
by Vivek 2024

Contributions to Vivek 2024 are
not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax
purposes.

Funds received in response to
this solicitation are subject to federal contribution limits.
Contributions from corporations, labor unions, foreign nationals
without green cards, and federal government contractors are
prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to
collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and
name of employer for individuals whose contributions exceed $200
in an election cycle.

[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-azdyhk-tkwdjuidt-r/) Hi Peter, This week on Unleashed, we go all in on how to **WIN BACK THE WEST**... I know yours hasn't either, that's why you are here. I decided the most important first step for us to do better is to learn the lessons from the last couple years, for me to share what I saw, what I know now we are up against. ## IRS Ends 'Unannounced' Visits to Homes
The IRS has ended its decade-old program of [making unannounced visits ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojOB8YwMHTJlq4drQPOCRW2IyBO8_dVOnd8esvT-7rMF0o5bddPWtm1ZZ8ptHTwDJNALVDO2Ee3MCPLnt2gLUht9Yj9zQUbljAoY4FoGFFaS2G00pCZDARv--QQUMKEGqzUozoheh7GEfwQtNeD7hRwTG0vp-89be3GS37tB5dT2Nc-u1tr99rJjw7PHZ7pvvGzvtUbSkshc4fnVKpo9CNqoLWKwgdvDxaVy5ECi1aY6qO8hIlqQOsRpNbM0Rs05KOBoEAZqWJfXLw_U86p6qlTcF0p5b-O9v-W3wAAAP__YZdigA)to homes to collect unfiled tax returns and money and will instead mail letters to people to schedule meetings.

Tax officials say they changed the controversial policy to combat scammers who impersonate IRS agents and for the safety of real agents who have been threatened both on social media and in person by surprised homeowners.

The policy came under fire from Republicans after [journalist Matt Taibbi](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD3LpDAUhX-NdlfyoXEsLKYRtphtt5R8XPUuMZEkKvPvF7d-q3PgwOHh-fOZP5o8hfW33nEsS5y1LXThzHoQCoScRe3GBVGgrHHkamBSDaoT9TYupnWmt69BDi8-SCmtZAvvnVOD4y-ONY2CCcl6odggVdc2QhjkXccMt8oorqqWoaMSU_M3UigbLv4bL0yNjXvtx62UI1fyXYmpEtN9382ew7NVYsIAZ67EFPB-4oieCtmnUspQImBwsMdc4Aw6hHgGiw62uCNclKlkSHhhyhRWcGi1www-hhWO9BiwCHopmEB7jys60ObM-NzrBO83R_qaX3Ua3XGT95RVX7Vs3TX5_-zlZ5X_AgAA___WnXga) received an unannounced visit from IRS agents on the same day he testified in Congress about Twitter colluding with government agencies.
## Woman Admits Lying About Toddler, Kidnapping
Carlee Russell, the Alabama woman who disappeared for two days and then reappeared claiming she was kidnapped after chasing a toddler on the highway, admitted [she made up the whole thing.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFutSAYgOGrwQ0DHwoyMPzJH7fTpWk6GoQPpUExQM_pufumnTu_y5vn_bbcbEzx3F7sgaaFvFjX4h0XpihICmKBzpuACCg6NFxqJqSWI3S7GSeunVRydT7ooMNk-TCtgitveXADdNEAA8EUSKaFHIceYEU-jmzlTq6SSzIw9LHl0n_keLYdQ3rmO5be5aNLZm_tqkT8IzATmO3qTnzUfss_mcD89kpgdrYkRFo-a8WUKvWx2utCW-zpkO7ZflG327JhpVdO0SGBubZcnkTM0RPxnzMuudJq6orx1yOmFKtUZGDbYWP6PWl_w3wHAAD__6dAZCc)

Russell apologized in a statement, but police are weighing charges for the false 911 call, which made national headlines and set off a two-day search.

Police said the woman was never missing but they still [have no detail](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQRb9G6vDAwi5SQfEad35tSg1CK3sTLDSI2OO_zzh1yju3Oed8XKZLlCzb9X-8c2hrmWJq8uBJewWkwE7QL2FlBrY9B0OjtjQSQn8LENMaB2DPdsBhpZkBAWf0CJoSjr0E0GC1B9KjJXQngJkNop5NopkMdU7zIq3U02eRrd14za_y4HpK5d7ncGttPzr7r4NzB-e4b_w83td71CYpcwfnFGtmVvX7ODhn9SXLFvddtqs6WqkvVbnVt1PZ1KAjOTNYt5LVBgmMT24mIETjnUt9Dcv-lJzlIN85fb1Hyb8s7e80PwEAAP__3pxjKQ) on where she went, or why, during those two days.
## Biden's Dog Loves Biting Secret Service Agents
President Biden's German shepherd Commander has bitten Secret Service officers [ten times in four months](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAQQH-NvRHBgc94YOiSLV07WnwcyVXYRBg56r-v0rnj01ue3tdtvXkuvN8__Uau57r62PmkVc4CUIBeYUwuEwHpkZzCRWpccILx4aLOCDZkiUvylJRRk7cWkDx6O1EY2YEELWdAuWiczAUgkJomGVTEgAoHIylxr-3yXXnvD8rlp57ULrFuY3GP3p_HoD8GuA5w9c-dXsdbvaF1joUGuAZOtItU7-Kg2KiLg9rJkUSs2-b3RE0E7iTsYowFZbK0Gij5kMAuRubZQ7TJxLG59HxxKXzgPBh53zyXv5D-_5ffAAAA__8VMmMB), sending at least one to the hospital. One agent reportedly used a steel cart to protect himself from attack.

This is Biden's second dog since becoming President. The first, Major, was [ousted from the White House](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3ojORwxhYOjiLV07WmDOMRXmLPuUKv--Sudun_RJT0_v6z7dY6mlPT7jRkEWnuIs5UkTOI1Wo5mwy2EhQjIdhd56MNbbAbs1LIO3xtFCPmVy_oYu3cCA8egdUPZdCQhowKEFb-xwvSAm6ocBUj_bZHurrkC5CB-Xby5NVlrqi590XGbeuhpWkf1U5kPhqHBsr51PeV8KxzdY4QjuvQeFYyqZms780DNvW2yZDp2KaD60rAdFoUZZ96B34r2SPqmJ5kZaWK987kViVTh2R8j7T6m1nNapKzy2WOqfjvxf5zcAAP__W35kow) for similar aggressive behavior.

Commander's behavior came to light through a lawsuit filed by conservative watchdog group Judicial Watch. The group received nearly 200 pages of Secret Service records detailing Commander's reign of terror.

Police said the woman was never missing but they still on where she went, or why, during those two days. One agent reportedly used a steel cart to protect himself from attack. This is Biden's second dog since becoming President. The first, Major, was for similar aggressive behavior. Commander's behavior came to light through a lawsuit filed by conservative watchdog group Judicial Watch. The group received nearly 200 pages of Secret Service records detailing Commander's reign of terror. subject: Our nation desperately needs The New York Sun
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW1m90_DNQ

You may already know that I spent most of my career in publishing
and helped build the third largest newspaper company in the
western world.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW1m90_DNQ

FROM THE
DESK OF CONRAD BLACK

You may
already know that I spent most of my career in publishing and
helped build the third largest newspaper company in the western
world.

We
published over 400 titles, including the London Daily Telegraph,
Chicago Sun Times, Jerusalem Post, Spectator, and most of the
leading newspapers in Canada and Australia.

I am
proud to have also been one of the founders of the modern New
York Sun, and believe that now, more than ever, it is a paper
that is uniquely suited for this moment of crisis in journalism.

Too many
journalists are not only failing to live up to public
expectations but are actively abusing public trust. Instead of
policing the powerful on behalf of the public, they police the
public on behalf of the powers they favor.

The New
York Sun has never lost sight of who it serves. It's a patriotic
newspaper that places principle over politics and people over
party. That is why I am happy to be a weekly contributor to it.
It maintains the highest professional standards without being
pedantic or boring. It's a community where I am proud to belong.

The Sun
is a lone voice among a sea of major publications owned by
multi-billion-dollar corporations that generally try to stifle
dissent.

The only
one way the Sun can win is if we all join in its effort.
Collectively we cannot be overwhelmed by any media conglomerate
or oppressive, woke, media groupthink. The Sun has long advocated
on our behalf. Now, if we join the Sun's movement to restore
American journalism, we will be unstoppable.

Membership starts at just 1¢ a day. I encourage you to sign up
now. Every single person counts.

Join the
Sun now →

Please
join us in the fight to restore America's journalism.

This is a
newspaper that our country desperately needs.

Conrad
Black
Columnist
for The New York Sun

* * *
Fellow American - people are waking up.

People are hungry for a cause.

People want to hear **COLD HARD TRUTHS**.

People are ready for a REVOLUTION.

_**[Fellow American, are you with me?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvs8k9asb4gct856l5hj93uch9hj88supp9cs9qo_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpgeeoj1clh2bs)**_

I am crisscrossing the country, on the trail every day, speaking with voters in Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina.

But we're also going where other Republican presidential candidates haven't been. We're in deep blue areas like South Side Chicago and Kensington.

I am ready to work harder than ever before, but to keep this going, I need YOU.

**[Every dollar we raise in the next 72 hours will help us keep this momentum going. Even just $5 will make a difference to help me secure a center stage spot during the first Presidential Debate next month.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zql0d07e7d2q2gpaovlpk6thluaq6ddn32t2n52o_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpgeeoj1clh2bs)**

With our surge in the polls, the Washington insiders are rattled. The knives are coming out - so I am going to need your help now more than ever to support our movement.

**[Please, in the next 72 hours, chip whatever you can.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj2b2q3lde4vla8j2k9udugmemtn18qu07vjeog8_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpgeeoj1clh2bs)**

I'll always stand up for the truth and answer the hard questions facing Americans today.

But this gives me hope for our future.

We're the explorers, the pioneers, the unafraid. In God we trust & in government we distrust. That's what makes America great. _That's what makes America itself._

Thanks,

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zul1sm81drptt9ophvvmjr9gre54qmevmelo9j48_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpgeeoj1clh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** BE A PART OF OUR MOVEMENT ->**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8rouglkad9uq1re6b30n9ti5l262672ba6ffclg_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpgeeoj1clh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Our message of TRUTH is resonating with voters according to the latest polling.

|

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu8p26g6btsavmtel47di27rfh87d3bp94d52c1o_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpie0o76cdh2bs)

Vivek Ramaswamy - 12%
Ron DeSantis - 12%

* * *
Fellow American - people are waking up.

People are hungry for a cause.

People want to hear **COLD HARD TRUTHS**.

People are ready for a REVOLUTION.

_**[Fellow American, are you with me?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zk9n9pu877k618acq9a6f9pp0hcll0kbel9dtb0o_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpie0o76cdh2bs)**_

I am crisscrossing the country, on the trail every day, speaking with voters in Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina.

But we're also going where other Republican presidential candidates haven't been. We're in deep blue areas like South Side Chicago and Kensington.

I am ready to work harder than ever before, but to keep this going, I need YOU.

**[Every dollar we raise in the next 72 hours will help us keep this momentum going. Even just $5 will make a difference to help me secure a center stage spot during the first Presidential Debate next month.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc4iol7m05s8q58lhr6t5dvfp9e0ubcte4hu49p0_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpie0o76cdh2bs)**

With our surge in the polls, the Washington insiders are rattled. The knives are coming out - so I am going to need your help now more than ever to support our movement.

**[Please, in the next 72 hours, chip whatever you can.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn2as6b595fo2t0rrme23i1d9rqf5qvt6qoonaq8_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpie0o76cdh2bs)**

I'll always stand up for the truth and answer the hard questions facing Americans today.

But this gives me hope for our future.

We're the explorers, the pioneers, the unafraid. In God we trust & in government we distrust. That's what makes America great. _That's what makes America itself._

Thanks,

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfj5fv14h6f6kcrbdhu2qk7cdk7fj6365hd09dd8_rp22sh2s8i66p70cpie0o76cdh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. Friends,
On Episode 2 of the State Freedom Caucus Network's ongoing podcast series, I interview HFC member Congressman Warren Davidson from Ohio.
Rep. Davidson was the first congressional candidate that the House Freedom Caucus ever supported when he won a 15-way primary for the seat that former Speaker John Boehner resigned from. Since winning that special election in 2016, he has been one of the best conservative fighters that we have in Congress.
We talked at length about America's monetary policy, specifically the looming threat that Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) pose to our financial freedom. Our state freedom caucuses have led the fight to prevent CBDCs from coming to their states and Rep. Davidson has sponsored numerous pieces of legislation in Congress to battle CBDCs. Davidson is currently sounding the alarm that the Federal Reserve is creating the so-called CBDC Death Star as we speak.
In order to view the episode, you must become a paying subscriber to the Network on our Substack page. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Douglas=20Carswell?=
subject: Ben & Jerry’s History of America – update from Mississippi’s conservative advocacy organization
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/affirmativeaction-11570938?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear Friend,
**July 4th is a big deal in America.** Folk don’t merely celebrate the day that thirteen former British colonies broke away from Britain back in 1776. Americans, I discovered when I moved here, spend July 4th reveling in being American. **No matter when it was that you or your ancestors moved over here, July 4th is an occasion to rejoice that they did.**
**So, it is hard to overstate how offensive it was for Ben & Jerry’s, the ice cream vendor, to mark the day with a tweet claiming that “the US exists on stolen Indigenous land”, which should be “returned”.**
---
|
---
_The tweet that Ben & Jerry’s sent on July 4th _
| **What possessed Ben & Jerry’s, part of the global Unilever conglomerate, to say something quite so gratuitously offensive?**
Ben & Jerry’s are not only guilty of bad history (Indigenous American tribes were busy “stealing” land from other indigenous Americans long before the Mayflower showed up). They are guilty of hypocrisy.
**While attacking America for existing on “stolen land”, Ben & Jerry’s parent company, Unilever, sells ice cream to Putin’s Russia, a country that is actually engaged in stealing bits of Ukraine.**
Unilever says it is still operating in Russia because “for companies like Unilever, which have a significant physical presence in the country, exiting is not straightforward” and because “were we to abandon our business and brands in the country, they would be appropriated – and then operated – by the Russian state”.
**It’s not just Ben & Jerry’s. Earlier this year, Bud Light, one of America’s top beer brands, decided it was time to distance the brand from its “frat guy” customers and embrace transgender “inclusivity”.** Before that, Disney, a leading family entertainment business, made a big deal of backing a radical stance on social issues.
As Vivek Ramaswamy, a potential future Vice President, has been energetically pointing out, many of America’s leading fund managers impose explicitly “woke” agendas on the businesses they invest in.
What we once called “political correctness” has long been evident on American university campuses. But until relatively recently, that’s where it stayed. Now these ideas are moving mainstream.
When a big corporation indulges in “woke” signaling, I used to assume that they knew what they are doing. When Bud Light decided to embrace transgenderism, I imagined it was all part of a cunning marketing plan by clever MBAs to sell more beer.
**Perhaps when “woke” ideas take hold of an institution, it is really a sign that those running it are out of any other ideas and bereft of intelligent insights.** Look at what happened with some of these “woke” corporations next.
Bud Light’s marketing campaign offended their core customer base, and sales fell by about a third. Disney’s share price fell significantly.
**To be “woke” is to have a sense of moral superiority** , since those that are “woke” regard themselves as having “woken up” to the unjust ways of the world. They believe that they have a heightened sense of social injustice that others lack. **This can cause otherwise intelligent and highly educated people to make some remarkably stupid decisions.**
If being “woke” is bad business, why does it keep happening? We are seeing the consequences of two decades of having “woke” HR departments across corporate America.
For years, big firms have been recruiting and promoting people on the basis of diversity and inclusion – or even their commitment to combating climate change. An organization that recruits and promotes people on the basis of anything other than competence at their actual job risks becoming incompetent. **A lot of fairly mediocre people have been overpromoted to the point where their mediocrity is starting to stand out.**
We are starting to see a long overdue correction: and it would be a good thing if Ben & Jerry’s took the same kind of hit that Bud Light did.
---

Douglas Carswell

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

# [#]https://go.josh4congress.com/a/jg-antisemitism-2307 [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/jg-antisemitism-2307]

This is disgraceful.

It’s truly abhorrent that this kind of antisemitic conspiracy theory is getting any airtime, and for the record — my whole family, who is Jewish — got COVID.

This is just another incident in a continued, despicable surge in antisemitism across New Jersey and our country. The magnitude of the crisis we are facing calls for concerted action, at every level, to ensure that there truly is no place for hate in our state, in our local communities, or anywhere in our nation.

I’ve been at the forefront of combating antisemitism for years now — even before coming to Congress. Speaking up and out — even against those in my own party — whenever and wherever we see it.

Will you stand with me against this latest attack by adding your name and pledging to do your part to end antisemitism, and fight for a future without hate? [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/jg-antisemitism-2307]
STAND WITH ME [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/jg-antisemitism-2307]

Thank you,

Josh

Risky offshore drilling irreparably harms our coasts, communities, and climate. Just one oil spill would spell catastrophe for beaches, Indigenous and coastal communities, marine wildlife, and fishermen alike. Allowing new oil and gas leases not only poses significant risks to our environment but also fails to address the key issues we face today. The production of U.S. oil does not set the price of gas; instead, it is subject to fluctuations in the global oil market. New leasing would do nothing to lower gas prices, as it would take at least five years for oil from new leases to reach the market.

It is clear that the decision to expand offshore drilling is driven by short-term gains rather than considering the long-term impacts on our environment and the well-being of future generations. The Big Oil industry is pushing for an expansion of current offshore oil drilling beyond the 12 million acres of ocean waters they already have the rights to — and they’re only using a quarter of that. clean_body: The Biden Administration is proposing a massive expansion of offshore drilling ... | | Dear Friend, The Biden Administration is proposing a massive expansion of offshore drilling leases in the Gulf of Mexico, and possibly Alaska. These new leases go directly against President Biden's commitment to cut carbon emissions and are incompatible with a desperate need to combat climate change and protect struggling ecosystems. We need a huge public outcry to convince President Biden and his administration to reverse course before it's too late. You can take immediate action to prevent this dangerous path forward. | Risky offshore drilling irreparably harms our coasts, communities, and climate. Just one oil spill would spell catastrophe for beaches, Indigenous and coastal communities, marine wildlife, and fishermen alike. Allowing new oil and gas leases not only poses significant risks to our environment but also fails to address the key issues we face today. The production of U.S. oil does not set the price of gas; instead, it is subject to fluctuations in the global oil market. New leasing would do nothing to lower gas prices, as it would take at least five years for oil from new leases to reach the market. It is clear that the decision to expand offshore drilling is driven by short-term gains rather than considering the long-term impacts on our environment and the well-being of future generations. The Big Oil industry is pushing for an expansion of current offshore oil drilling beyond the 12 million acres of ocean waters they already have the rights to — and they’re only using a quarter of that. The reality is that leasing our ocean to oil and gas companies will only lock us into the climate-destroying fossil fuels of the past for decades to come — which is exactly what the fossil fuel industry wants — at a time when we need to be rapidly transitioning to 100% clean energy to save our planet. | Paid for by the Natural Resources Defense Council. # Our Latest Efforts Against the Weaponization of Government
---
This week, we announced the expansion of our Weaponization of Government Initiative. We are adding the expertise and knowledge of Nicole Parker, former FBI Special Agent, who will serve as a Senior Advisor for AFPI’s Center for Law and Justice. The Center is chaired by former Acting U.S. Attorney General Matt Whitaker and former Florida Attorney General Pam Bondi.
|
---
_Nicole Parker at our Speaker Series Event "Back the Blue Police Week: Honoring Our Heroes"_
“We are living in a time when the very foundations of our democracy are being tested. It seems the Left is using vast powers of the government to intimidate, investigate, and prosecute those with whom they disagree while protecting themselves and those aligned with their radical interests,” said Pam Bondi. “The addition of former FBI Special Agent Nicole Parker, combined with our new website, will further our mission to highlight the truth and present solutions that ensure a renewed culture of transparency and accountability.”

In addition, we have initiated an investigation into the National Archives Records Administration (NARA) pertaining to the indictment of former President Trump by filing a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request. In accordance with this request, we will examine the role of the National Archives in procuring the indictment, in particular, concerning NARA’s adherence to or lack thereof to the Presidential Records Act. With that in mind, we have filed a FOIA request with the Archives requesting information related to past records of past presidents and senior cabinet officers. **[Read this FOIA request HERE](https://carlasands.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=99d251bf9c4705c4eb727273b&id=2d2c095596&e=b254a3b575)**.

We are also launching a new **[Weaponization of Government website](https://carlasands.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=99d251bf9c4705c4eb727273b&id=d78de7b294&e=b254a3b575)** , building on extensive work of holding the Biden Administration accountable and addressing the clear weaponization of government against political opponents. The site will be a resource that houses all policy documents that will educate the public on their rights and how they can defend themselves against unconstitutional government overreach and weaponization.

# Key Takeaways from our “Combating Fentanyl - The America First Action Plan” Event
On July 13, we hosted Members of Congress, including U.S. Senator Roger Marshall (R-KS) and U.S. Representative Mark Green (TN-07), and AFPI Policy Center Chairs, including Kellyanne Conway, Pam Bondi, Steve Yates, and Matt Whitaker, to discuss the fentanyl epidemic plaguing our country and our proposed America First solutions to the issue.

The America First Action Plan to solve the fentanyl crisis involves four key areas:
* First, we must secure the border—to stop the drug flow into our Nation and to punish the Mexican drug cartels, who are public enemy number one for targeting our youth with deadly fentanyl.
* Second, we need to get tough on China by imposing penalties for the transmission of fentanyl precursors to Mexican cartels.
* Third, we must implement stricter law enforcement penalties for those that take any role in the manufacturing and distribution of fentanyl.
* And finally, we need to target the scourge of fentanyl poisoning through our education and public health systems, including by making life-saving reversal agents readily available to the public.

Did you miss this discussion? **[You can catch the event recap HERE](https://carlasands.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=99d251bf9c4705c4eb727273b&id=f82c49bdb7&e=b254a3b575)** or watch the key takeaways below.

Our event kicked off with a discussion between Pam Bondi, Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost, and Texas mother, Stefanie Turner. During the discourse, Stefanie Turner shared her heart-wrenching story of losing her son, Tucker, to fentanyl.

If you take nothing else from our event, we ask you to listen to Stefanie's story—one all too common for families across the country as a result of this deadly drug epidemic.
Stefanie's story reminds us that the conversations around the dangers of fentanyl are not just about statistics. Instead, they are, most importantly, a discussion on real people, real families, and real loss.

name: Sepi Shyne
subject: The first declaration of equality for people with disabilities.
body:
The Americans with Disabilities Act was an important milestone in our nation’s struggle for civil rights, but it was the floor, not the ceiling.
Team,

The story of the Americans with Disabilities Act did not begin on July 26, 1990, when President Bill Clinton put his pen on the monumental piece of legislation.

It began decades before when people with disabilities began challenging societal barriers and attitudes that had for too long excluded them, when parents began to fight against the segregation of their children, and when activists in the disabilities rights movement lobbied, protested, and fought for equal treatment, dignity, and opportunity.

**To them, we owe our deepest gratitude and respect.** Their organizing efforts led to our nation’s — and the world’s — first declaration of equality for people with disabilities; impacting the lives of millions of people and shifting our collective attitudes closer toward true inclusivity.

[**Remember this important milestone in our nation’s struggle for civil rights by adding your name to the petition calling on Congress to continue the work of the ADA and expand the rights of people with disabilities today. >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67082262/418542504/135770504?ms=em23_230726_ADA_adv_gq_act___SS_ettx&refcode=em23_230726_ADA_adv_gq_act___SS_ettx&source=em23_230726_ADA_adv_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230726_ADA_adv_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=ChVAj9J3vk05S8369NhhMj4PONY/pPsTWkSj0s2I8jqPC6ZOo/jBM+um5k2ihuOOYT2CMToFEMVPOV/H+RbudrsWGmZuSgrS8NF0+q1/k+JSL/8hPM7XmisepyBeA9lbVllm3/8T53dxJkoAw10YYg==&refcode2=6b03f653-cd2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmIwM2Y2NTMtY2QyYi1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cpbtp9TFY6TtBy0XdMzDmG3Ml1T-B7Zw4PHCcE2_KMo=&emci=6d9d4945-142b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=6b03f653-cd2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=13528480)

The Americans with Disabilities Act prohibits disability discrimination in the workplace and by state and local governments, ensures equal access to healthcare, social services, and transportation. It also provides standards for access to public spaces and affirms the inherent rights of people with disabilities to participate fully in every aspect of American life

But there is still so much more work that needs to be done for our nation to fully realize true inclusion and equality.

From housing accessibility and affordability, to disparities in health and education outcomes, we must keep moving the needle forward to protect the rights and dignity of people with disabilities.

I am calling on Congress to keep building on the work of disability rights activists to fund more accessible housing, increase funding for special education programs and programs to eliminate education disparities, and finally put an end to systemic discrimination faced by the disabled community.

clean_body: The Americans with Disabilities Act was an important milestone in our nation’s struggle for civil rights, but it was the floor, not the ceiling. Team, The story of the Americans with Disabilities Act did not begin on July 26, 1990, when President Bill Clinton put his pen on the monumental piece of legislation. It began decades before when people with disabilities began challenging societal barriers and attitudes that had for too long excluded them, when parents began to fight against the segregation of their children, and when activists in the disabilities rights movement lobbied, protested, and fought for equal treatment, dignity, and opportunity. To them, we owe our deepest gratitude and respect. Their organizing efforts led to our nation’s — and the world’s — first declaration of equality for people with disabilities; impacting the lives of millions of people and shifting our collective attitudes closer toward true inclusivity. The Americans with Disabilities Act prohibits disability discrimination in the workplace and by state and local governments, ensures equal access to healthcare, social services, and transportation. It also provides standards for access to public spaces and affirms the inherent rights of people with disabilities to participate fully in every aspect of American life But there is still so much more work that needs to be done for our nation to fully realize true inclusion and equality. From housing accessibility and affordability, to disparities in health and education outcomes, we must keep moving the needle forward to protect the rights and dignity of people with disabilities. I am calling on Congress to keep building on the work of disability rights activists to fund more accessible housing, increase funding for special education programs and programs to eliminate education disparities, and finally put an end to systemic discrimination faced by the disabled community. With gratitude, Sepi Shyne #WomanLifeFreedom Mayor Sepi Shyne has taken on WeHo's biggest issues and delivered results. name: Peter Welch
subject: The flooding in Vermont
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU)
Hi Friend,
The recent flooding in Vermont has devastated our state. Homes have been destroyed, farms have been washed out, and businesses have been damaged.
This is particularly hard on those who have the least. Folks who work hard everyday and live paycheck to paycheck, who may have seen their homes or property washed away.
We have to work together to recover. My office is continuing to work every day alongside Senator Sanders and Congresswoman Balint to bring every federal resource available back to Vermont to rebuild, and my offices are taking calls from constituents to help folks individually.
I’ve lived in Vermont for many years. One thing that has always given me great pride is the way that Vermonters help their neighbors when they need it. I’ve met so many people who have been impacted by the flooding, but even more who are stepping up to lend a helping hand.
That’s the Vermont Way.
There are multiple ways you can help your fellow Vermonters right now:
* [Register to volunteer](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5529?t=3&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU).
* Document any damage [you](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5530?t=4&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU) or [your business ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5531?t=5&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU)has sustained. The more Vermonters report their damage, the better the state will be able to estimate the cost to recover from the flooding.
* [Donate to the Vermont Farm Fund](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5532?t=6&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU), which provides emergency loans to farms.
* [Donate to the Vermont Flood Response and Recovery Fund](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5533?t=7&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU), supporting Vermonters impacted by and responding to the flooding.

For more resources to stay safe and recover from the flooding, visit [https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5535?t=9&akid;=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/5534?t=8&akid=1267%2E61531%2EPQuLRU).
This is going to be a long road to recovery. But by working together, we can rebuild even better than before.
Thanks,
Peter Welch

Hung Cao's story is almost too amazing to believe, and I am honored that he joined me for this week's Hold The Line podcast. Hung was born in Vietnam, and his family fled the country following the North Vietnamese takeover before settling in Virginia. Now, Hung Cao is answering another call to serve - running for United States Senate in Virginia.

Hung graduated from the United States Naval Academy and became a special operations officer, serving in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. While raised Buddhist, Cao became a Christian while in the Naval Academy. Hung is a true warrior of the faith, as well as a warrior on the battlefield, continually sharing his faith on the battlefield with fellow SEALs team members.

Listen below as Hung Cao shares personal stories of being a Vietnamese immigrant, retired Navy Captain, Believer, and candidate for the U.S. Senate.

clean_body: | | | | | | Fellow American, Hung Cao's story is almost too amazing to believe, and I am honored that he joined me for this week's Hold The Line podcast. Hung was born in Vietnam, and his family fled the country following the North Vietnamese takeover before settling in Virginia. Now, Hung Cao is answering another call to serve - running for United States Senate in Virginia. Hung graduated from the United States Naval Academy and became a special operations officer, serving in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. While raised Buddhist, Cao became a Christian while in the Naval Academy. Hung is a true warrior of the faith, as well as a warrior on the battlefield, continually sharing his faith on the battlefield with fellow SEALs team members. Listen below as Hung Cao shares personal stories of being a Vietnamese immigrant, retired Navy Captain, Believer, and candidate for the U.S. Senate. 🎧LISTEN ON ITUNES⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎ My heart is to see the next generation of leaders stand strong and stand tall. | | Hi Peter – I wanted to make sure you saw this email from Brian.

Throughout his life – from his service in the Air Force to his work as a doctor to his time as a political appointee – Brian has learned how important it is to listen, learn, and serve. He knows every voice matters and everyone can make a difference.

**As a key member of our grassroots network, we want to make sure we get your feedback on what issues are most important to you, especially in the early days of this campaign.

Here’s a link to use: [drbrianwilliamsforcongress.com/priorities](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67086472/418550314/-1721731258?source=EM_NBI_BW_20230726_SV_IssuesSurvey_0_3MO_TeamWilliams_na_na_Issues02&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTJjOTc3OTUtY2YyYi1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j-oXl3jlUi13XJ70gaKDxnTNfS_S5D-RBvkl23hyW3Y=&emci=3ab44314-682a-ee11-a9bb-00224832e1ba&emdi=e2c97795-cf2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=13153572)**
* * *
_Brian's Original Message:_

Peter,

When deciding to run for Congress, the experiences and stories of my patients motivated me. From the hospital frontlines, I’ve seen the impact of our nation’s epidemic of gun violence, the crisis of healthcare affordability, and attacks on reproductive freedom. Time and time again, my career in medicine has been defined by systems that fail my patients, so now **I am answering the call to serve.**

I have seen firsthand what is at stake, and as a political appointee in Dallas, and as a policy advisor in Washington, D.C. I've been inspired by what is possible. To create real change, we need a bold leader to fight for you and your family – for affordable healthcare, for your reproductive rights, and to protect our communities from the danger of gun violence.

These are the issues that drove me to run for office. But at this point in the campaign, I now want to hear about the issues that matter most to you most. **Because I value service before self–an ethos I internalized from my earliest days as a cadet at the United States Air Force Academy.** I am running to make sure **_your_** voices are heard in Congress, and I look forward to reading all of your responses.

[I want to know what’s on your mind, Peter, because your voice is front and center in our campaign. Let me know the issues you care about by filling out this brief survey.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67086474/418550315/-1721731258?source=EM_NBI_BW_20230726_SV_IssuesSurvey_0_3MO_TeamWilliams_na_na_Issues02&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTJjOTc3OTUtY2YyYi1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j-oXl3jlUi13XJ70gaKDxnTNfS_S5D-RBvkl23hyW3Y=&emci=3ab44314-682a-ee11-a9bb-00224832e1ba&emdi=e2c97795-cf2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=13153572) | [TAKE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67086475/418550316/-1721731258?source=EM_NBI_BW_20230726_SV_IssuesSurvey_0_3MO_TeamWilliams_na_na_Issues02&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTJjOTc3OTUtY2YyYi1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j-oXl3jlUi13XJ70gaKDxnTNfS_S5D-RBvkl23hyW3Y=&emci=3ab44314-682a-ee11-a9bb-00224832e1ba&emdi=e2c97795-cf2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=13153572)

In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

name: Mark Robinson
subject: Can I share a quick story?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Mark Robinson
body:
I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth.

| |
---
| | | | | I grew up as the 9th of 10 children in Greensboro. My father was an alcoholic who beat my mother. He died when I was in the fifth grade, and I was terrified. He had been the sole provider for our household. I remember sitting on the porch wondering where I'd be in five years.

Would I be in a shelter?

In foster care?

Would I be separated from my brothers and sisters?
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r)
---

A few days after my father died, my mom's friend came by. She explained that now that her husband was gone, my mother could kick her feet up and relax because the government would take care of everything.

But that wasn't my mom.

As soon as her friend left, she got up and walked over to the local university and got a job as a janitor. She had a fifth-grade education and five kids to provide for. She chose to clean up for other kids to provide for her own. **She didn 't just rise to the challenge, she excelled. **

She gave a sense of calm and purpose to us. From that point on, we always had what we needed... _very little of what we wanted, but always what we needed. _

My mother was and always will be my hero. She showed me what strength and perseverance looked like first hand, and she taught me that with faith and hard work, I could achieve anything.

Those early years of hardship were just the beginning of my struggles.

My wife and I have endured a lot. I lost not one, but two jobs due to NAFTA.

We lost homes, cars, and were even forced into bankruptcy.

I remember lying awake at night wondering how I was going to pay the bills.

_**But I never forgot what my mother taught me, and we never gave up. **_

Together, my wife of over 30 years and I persevered and raised two incredible children. Now we have two amazing grandkids.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r)
---

In 2018, my life changed when I gave a speech to the Greensboro city council that went viral.

A year later, I launched my campaign for Lieutenant Governor, and when I was elected in 2020, _**I became the first black Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina. **_

As Lieutenant Governor, I have had the privilege to work on a lot of issues, but my main focus has been on education.

It is a passion of mine, and the reason I ran for Lieutenant Governor. I have been a vocal proponent of parents knowing what their children are being taught. I have supported providing opportunities for all students to have an education that best suits them, whether that's in a private school, charter school, home school, or public school.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r)
---

Now, I've thrown my hat in the ring to be the next Governor of North Carolina. Not because I want to be Governor.

My campaign for Governor is not about want. _**IT 'S ABOUT SERVICE.**_

Some day, you and I will be gone. And I don't want my family to see a picture of me and wonder why I didn't fight for them. I want my children and grandchildren to know that I did everything I could. That's what I'm fighting for. And that's why I'm running for Governor.

Now, I'm asking for your help.

_**This is going to be the most contested and most expensive governor 's race in the country.**_ As North Carolina goes, the nation goes. So I hope you will consider making a contribution to my campaign today. _**[Every single donation will get us one step closer to making history.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r "Whether
it’s $500 or just $5, every single donation will get us one step closer to making history.")**_
---
| | | **[Donate Now](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r)**
---
Thanks in advance for your support, donations, and prayers.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/63004446:6pHzBIINT:m:1:3299561967:3368837D7A3A1BEB4750DEE5F49198EC:r)
---

Mark Robinson

# An Important Message from
# Gloucester County Chairwoman Jacci Vigilante
about Board of Education Candidates
---
| The filing deadline to be a candidate for the Board of Education is Monday, July 31st, 2023.
Petitions must be in by 4:00 PM at Board of Elections (550 Grove Rd, West Deptford)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
The choice is yours
#

Team -
Today, we hope you’ll allow us to share five reasons as to why your $5 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC is so important.
1. **The United States has higher rates of gun violence than any other developed country in the world.** We have had over 400 mass shootings in our country this year—and it’s only July. This is not normal, and we _cannot_ accept this as our status quo.

2. **We currently have a Republican majority in the House and a narrowly divided Senate.** That means we are going to have to fight harder than ever before for commonsense gun safety legislation, like universal background checks, to get passed at the federal level. With the monumental progress we have made with the passage of the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ last year, we must work together to let our elected officials know that we’re not backing down in the fight to keep our communities safe.

3. **We are already preparing to maintain our gun safety majority in the Senate in 2024.** We just made our first Senate endorsement of the election cycle, and we’ll have many more to come. The work to win at the ballot box next November starts now, and we need your support to elect gun safety champions at the state, local, and federal levels.

4. **Your support sends a message to the gun lobby that our movement is stronger than ever.** Even though NRA membership has recently declined, the organization’s influence remains strong on far too many extreme politicians. That’s why it’s important we raise the funds we need to stand up to the gun lobby’s large sums of money.

5. **In less than a week, we’ll be closing the books on our July fundraising drive.** Right now, we’re still pacing behind on our goals. Your donation of $5—or any amount you can afford—makes a huge difference in helping us get to where we need to be.

The choice is yours, but we hope that these five reasons demonstrate the importance of your contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.
