| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ptv7rj7d4sq2auht54rbqqoc9li3d6g971q4vo_rp22sh2s8i66p70c5g66p32clh2bs)

Hello Friend,

I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

I have always loved my country.

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

When I started my investigation, I hadn't even met President Trump. **But this investigation changed my life forever ...**

_Trump did NOT collude with Russia_.

**My investigation discovered the FBI 's unlawful investigation. And what I found makes me believe that they did it _intentionall_ y to get rid of President Trump.**

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

Once I found the truth, that's when the spying began...

Since then, I knew I had to do everything to help American patriots by offering financial assistance to whistleblowers, veterans, patriots, and some families of Jan 6 detainees.

I go to great lengths to maintain the ability to go out and run 3 to 4 miles as many times as I can because it is my mental health therapy! I’ve found that I can solve most of my problems in the course of a good run. Even the things I can’t solve don’t seem as bad after a sweaty 3 to 4 miles. But my ideal run is a half marathon. I wake up knowing that I get to spend the next two or so hours running by myself, listening to some good music, enjoying the camaraderie of other runners, and celebrating being healthy enough to accomplish that distance. Once the adrenaline starts flowing, and I get in the groove, it goes by fast and I’m happy as a clam to be out there. Whether it’s running on the trail or running for Congress in the most competitive race in the entire nation, I always give it all I have…. So no matter what lies and attacks the Democrats throw at me in an attempt to capture this House seat, I’m going to put up a fight and never back down. But I can’t do it alone. I need help to make sure we run the strongest race possible. Here are three things you can do right now to help make sure Republicans keep control of the House: 1. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=96c3d312be4f3ff1bf4270bc0ee0e4e5fc1f11a0468c2560c1869715943107c1c52f9d6773ea8b264353886e5a4b963f769196d35f2660303b73f47821be5286 Make a donation to my campaign . Whether it’s just $5 or $500, anything you can contribute today will help us get our message out and combat the lies from the Democrats. 2. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=96c3d312be4f3ff1574308f634d7def926a9a2901be9ef4b0befe6807d3852330ae394d694cc9ec6db0e5d75e221319fdb641c4c6076a98a52266e514ed9edee Sign up to volunteer . Whether it is making phone calls, putting up a sign, or knocking on doors, I hope you will join our grassroots team. 3. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=96c3d312be4f3ff1a2dc8db37d4b45f43f1622926fb82b1c04af22853d9e937d9f857bdeca4acf4173ce1aa82824cea5ed861b2d61da65de49bca17ca39f762e Follow me on Facebook and SHARE our content. It may seem like a small thing, but it’s incredibly helpful to help us get the truth out! If you can tackle those three quick tasks right now, it will go a LONG way in helping make sure we WIN the race and keep the House in Republican hands. Hope to see you soon on the trail…or out on a run, Peter! We must be prepared to give 100% of our support to multiple candidates — candidates that will be the difference between protecting the White House, the Senate majority, and regaining the House. Because we don’t want to look back next year and wonder if there was more we could've done.
[**Can you please make your first contribution to The Long Run today to make sure we have the resources we need to continue building our critical movement?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jul23.p2zS7g&refcode=em230726-1-t2&t=3&akid=4681%2E196590%2EvjkTd0)

With gratitude,
Mandela

name: Dick Durbin
subject: End the death penalty (sign on now)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dick Durbin
body:
Support our legislation to stop capital punishment.
#
_“The death penalty experiment has failed. I no longer shall tinker with the machinery of death.”_
— Supreme Court Justice Harry Blackmun, 1994
Peter,
In 2000, the then-Governor of Illinois shocked the nation and declared a statewide moratorium on capital punishment. Before leaving office, Governor Ryan commuted 167 death sentences to life sentences, effectively renewing the national conversation about use of the death penalty.
By 2011, the state of Illinois had officially abolished the death penalty. It is long past time for the federal government to do the same — and my bill in the Senate is working to make it happen.
**[Along with Rep. Ayanna Pressley, I introduced legislation to end the death penalty at the federal level once and for all. Will you add your name right now as a citizen-cosponsor?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67095941/418571290/474517681?refcode=dd_em_230726_1&ms=dd_em_230726_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjI3NDYzZC1kZTJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LAxFa9kOjBOWNqbpM8TJYntuXMtwVAh6m2xrQc7q6YU=&emci=8b58bddd-d22b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=0f27463d-de2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=2727974)**
Extensive research and investigations into the application of the death penalty have revealed rampant injustices, including disproportionate use of capital punishment on people of color.
Dozens of wrongfully convicted prisoners have been exonerated. We’ve heard heartbreaking stories of people who received a death sentence, only to be proven innocent after their death.
Countless leaders who participated in the failed death penalty experiment over the years, like former Supreme Court Justices Harry Blackmun and John Paul Stevens, all concluded by the end of their careers that we should put a stop to this deeply-flawed practice.
****[We cannot in good conscience continue to send people to death row when we have demonstrated our inability to apply capital punishment in a fair way. End the injustice. End the death penalty. By 2011, the state of Illinois had officially abolished the death penalty. It is long past time for the federal government to do the same — and my bill in the Senate is working to make it happen. subject: Upcoming Events
body:
Hello Shelby County Conservatives,

We hope you’re having a great summer! There’s a lot going on in Shelby County over the next couple weeks.

This week, don’t miss the **GOP tent at the Shelby County Fair**! You can pick up Issue 1 signs and literature and register for our daily flag drawing.

Next week, come learn more about Issue 1 at our local **town hall**(details on attached flyer). Bring your friends, family and neighbors with you!

Every Saturday morning from 8-12 you can pick up Issue 1 yard signs and literature at the **GOP tent** at the corner of Main & Poplar in Sidney. Please stop by!

Voting is now underway in Ohio. You can **vote early** at the Board of Elections in Sidney **or on Election Day, August 8th,** at your precinct location. Vote **YES** on Issue 1! This is an extremely important election. Take a few minutes to read over the document below to understand how this Issue will affect us in rural Ohio.

Thanks for taking the time to educate yourself on such an important vote!

Best,
**The Shelby County Republican Party**

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Fwd: Upcoming Events
body:
Hello Shelby County Conservatives,

We hope you’re having a great summer! There’s a lot going on in Shelby County over the next couple weeks.

This week, don’t miss the **GOP tent at the Shelby County Fair**! You can pick up Issue 1 signs and literature and register for our daily flag drawing.

Next week, come learn more about Issue 1 at our local **town hall**(details on attached flyer). Bring your friends, family and neighbors with you!

Every Saturday morning from 8-12 you can pick up Issue 1 yard signs and literature at the **GOP tent** at the corner of Main & Poplar in Sidney. Please stop by!

Voting is now underway in Ohio. You can **vote early** at the Board of Elections in Sidney **or on Election Day, August 8th,** at your precinct location. Vote **YES** on Issue 1! This is an extremely important election. Take a few minutes to read over the document below to understand how this Issue will affect us in rural Ohio.

Thanks for taking the time to educate yourself on such an important vote!

Best,
**The Shelby County Republican Party**

[| [ Rural Ohio Issue-1 Fundamentals.pdf](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VeoQv6gnMpKqxzVJ-tDglBwJY7hsWbUq/view)[drive.google.com](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VeoQv6gnMpKqxzVJ-tDglBwJY7hsWbUq/view)|

MIGOP is thrilled to announce Dinesh D'Souza as a speaker for our upcoming Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference. | | | Can't see images? [Browser View](https://mailchi.mp/b80b8e78758c/mackinac-leadership-conference-speaker?e=a2af77507c)

# Party of the Constitution
---
|
---
| | MIGOP is thrilled to announce DINESH D'SOUZA as a speaker for our upcoming Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference. We are proud to have such a distinguished and respected individual speaking at our event.

Dinesh D’Souza is a bestselling author and award-winning filmmaker. His political documentaries “2016: Obama’s America” and “America: Imagine a World Without Her” are among the highest-grossing political films of all time. An immigrant who grew up in Mumbai, India, Dinesh came to the United States in 1978 as an exchange student. He attended Dartmouth College, graduating Phi Beta Kappa. He was a domestic policy analyst at the Reagan White House and also a scholar at think tanks such as the American Enterprise Institute and the Hoover Institution at Stanford. Dinesh has written nearly 20 books and made six documentaries and one feature film. He teamed up with his wife, Debbie, to produce a daily podcast that debuted in January of 2021 and is part of the Salem Podcast Network. In the spring of 2022, D’Souza media, along with True the Vote, exposed the truth about the 2020 election with the movie 2000 Mules. In the fall of 2023, he will release another timely documentary called _Police State._

For additional details about our Mackinac Island Conference, please [click here.](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=ad6e4c48f9&e=a2af77507c)

We look forward to seeing you there.

Wade – but that was only the beginning. Immediately following the Dobbs decision, states across the country began to embrace antiquated laws that either restricted or outright BANNED abortion. Some states even attempted to introduce laws to punish people who traveled to other states for abortions and encouraged neighbors to report one another for suspected abortions. But that was only the beginning. Because then, far-right extremists, unsatisfied with only restricting abortion in a couple dozen states, set their sights on restricting abortion nationwide. This plan came to fruition with Texas' attempts to discontinue mifepristone – the most widely used abortion pill in the nation. This proves just how vulnerable we are to a nationwide abortion ban. Peter, far-right lawmakers and judges will never stop their attempts to ban abortion in America until either they succeed or Congress codifies Roe v. Wade. That's why I'm throwing my support behind critical pieces of legislation like the Women's Health Protection Act to codify the right to choose – but I need you to join me. I'm counting on 5,000 fearless fighters to join me in standing up for reproductive freedom before midnight tonight, so please: | | Thank you for being in this fight with me. Folks,
Last month, Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution attacking me for holding Trump accountable.
After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.
They will never silence me — not now and not ever — but I need your help to fight back. With just a few days until our end-of-month deadline, every dollar counts. We face many pressing challenges as a country — affordable housing, access to health care, creating jobs, and so much more. Instead of addressing any of these challenges, Kevin McCarthy chose to take up this MAGA effort to distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing his bidding.
We've already known that the GOP is completely unhinged and beholden to Donald Trump.
With his call now to imprison me and primary any Republican who didn’t vote to censure me, Trump is telling the entire Republican Party that they must seek retribution against me politically and do whatever they can to prevent me from being elected to the Senate. This is not just a political stunt to rile up the MAGA base — it’s an attack on all accountability and constitutional oversight.
But make no mistake: If they thought this was going to deter me from holding Trump and his accomplices accountable or delivering real results for California and our nation, they thought wrong. I will not stop my fight to put truth and our democracy first — even if it means standing up to a twice-impeached ex-president and his lackeys.
With Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans ramping up their attacks against me, and our EOM deadline coming up, I’m going to need you by my side more than ever. Thank you,
— Adam

This law was passed in the dead of night, conflicting with a provision in the Illinois constitution guaranteeing bail. But the Illinois Supreme Court is under Democrat control. name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Help us stop Big Tech censorship
body:
Do you trust the government to decide what information is true?

| |
---
| | Fellow American, Do you trust the government to decide what information is true? _I know I don 't._ But state officials have been colluding with Big Tech companies to do exactly that. That's why we're suing Twitter and the California Secretary of State. Right now we're asking the Supreme Court of the United States to hear our case and stop the unholy collusion between Big Tech and the Big Government--collusion aimed to censor American citizens. But we need your help today. **[Which is why I'm asking you to add your name to the Center for American Liberty's Open Letter standing shoulder-to-shoulder Rogan O'Handley as his landmark First Amendment lawsuit goes before the Supreme Court.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=98e68b691dbd46999ba33a9cf7220708&_e=lekWaIhMvo7gscmf40C_IvK8v5SxxEKncD2nEK1eAVPadCq-HZu6W8YzUlg7lW7EIJD6pvpqgOBfAzEZtS44b8qYiNUcBejZnqtKqtBBlKeyhdGGFcy-BFu646BdIY1nHZd15eCuQGnZmkt1g-8PVQB_Dpx_-vTdMorcPnK1EZhBR4B6EGUcYAAzK0VIuzyjTxNpMZS2UZcFx0BR7husIA_rdFOxN-6eJPYOj0kEVKmYm9mQvXSJruEHeiZFlvwGsp-96YevKk1x_FIGgACvHZaXmANZhy2OdaxVh2dfsCgtNjwqnytvuwlwzlQkOarEplEYuCG0q1gyZEYxpN5NPuYtxTDomtUseF_IChJSoyPRhKpUl_u-j8jVi5tcuZX3)** For years, Big Tech giants have taken their marching orders from the radical Left. And these people think it's up to them to decide what's true. They think it's up to them to decide what you are and aren't allowed to say, to believe, and to share. And if you dare challenge what they've decided is true, they'll label you an agent of "misinformation" and shut you up. _That 's what happened to our client._ If you're on Twitter or Instagram, you might have heard of him. **His name is Rogan O 'Handley, but you might know him as "@DC_Draino."** And he did what many reasonable Americans did in 2020--he questioned the 2020 presidential election results and called for an audit. That's when then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla's office contacted Twitter employees instructing them to censor Rogan's tweets. I'm writing to you today because free speech is under attack and I need your help to defend it. **[Will you add your name to the Center for American Liberty's Open Letter of support for Rogan O'Handley and his First Amendment rights?](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=98e68b691dbd46999ba33a9cf7220708&_e=lekWaIhMvo7gscmf40C_IvK8v5SxxEKncD2nEK1eAVPadCq-HZu6W8YzUlg7lW7EIJD6pvpqgOBfAzEZtS44b8qYiNUcBejZnqtKqtBBlKeyhdGGFcy-BFu646BdIY1nHZd15eCuQGnZmkt1g-8PVQB_Dpx_-vTdMorcPnK1EZhBR4B6EGUcYAAzK0VIuzyjTxNpMZS2UZcFx0BR7husIJcYWeswNeJbZGmWuRepYUGKLgPEj2ld1pmZbBQdizN-ESDm4rj9_79CI4GKP09QBAXz3pkFF1EikWRXHCNXQL1pRb3q7Ca6qVv5vnWiBcs4qpD_vGV4H2_sCkp33N52EQQT9LLxp_DwJnMcwBSmTiQuvw_KULqHpSg18NGGn-WI)** This case is bigger than Rogan and it's bigger than Twitter. This all happened before Elon Musk bought the platform. If one political party gets to decide what information is allowed in the modern public square, free speech is dead as we know it. **And if politicians can get away with silencing Rogan, they can get away with silencing YOU.** Our attorneys are working around the clock on this case, and we've faced some devastating defeats. But we haven't given up because we know what this case means to the American people. And we're counting on patriots like you to rally around us right now and support the First Amendment. **[So please add your name to our Open Letter in support of Rogan O'Handley and together let's put a stop to Big Tech censorship.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=98e68b691dbd46999ba33a9cf7220708&_e=lekWaIhMvo7gscmf40C_IvK8v5SxxEKncD2nEK1eAVPadCq-HZu6W8YzUlg7lW7EIJD6pvpqgOBfAzEZtS44b8qYiNUcBejZnqtKqtBBlKeyhdGGFcy-BFu646BdIY1nHZd15eCuQGnZmkt1g-8PVQB_Dpx_-vTdMorcPnK1EZhBR4B6EGUcYAAzK0VIuzyjTxNpMZS2UZcFx0BR7husIHH4MUUA952T_qArFOPYfI3TRpMaNB39ENSAGv8JzJ3GJCmKjBbYvxU89cB7rH4DFuUXlF9P5ctRA7kX5q-qfUm47N0GuvoZNN5nGPKKJeCNK6-Bruu75C0NIOxI3zgkhslGkPJ_Qf2S0WkfjabFhs6aXhdo_kGP1zo90gIpAXg9)** It's really quite simple:
---
| | \- If one political viewpoint dictates what's allowed on social media, free speech ceases to exist in our country \- Without free speech, we can't have free or fair elections \- Big Tech and Big Government colluding to censor political opponents is a direct infringement of the First Amendment.
---
America as we know it is on the line, and we need conservatives like you to make your voice heard. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon
---
Founder & CEO

subject: FWD: Can you help ensure our national security?

Derek, as a veteran, our national security means so much to me.

That’s why it’s so important that we don’t let politics get in the way of the critical defense of our nation.

I just reached out about my colleague Sen. Tuberville and his opposition to over 250 senior military promotions. It’s silly, but he’s holding up this necessary procedure for his own political gain.
**[With just hours left to make your voice heard, can you let Sen. Tuberville know that politics can’t get in the way of our top military personnel performing their duties? Our national security is more important than partisan politics. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67101068/418588425/-629832227?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk856-su-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWNmNmVlOC1lYzJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XauPRBCIKPfiPoi4ZtW4TvoJ1QI8RnkqNxpG26yrxvc=&emci=70959f9a-0b2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=69cf6ee8-ec2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=21278485)**

| | |

Derek, it’s Chrissy. You know me – I try to see the best in everyone and work hard to lower the temperature of our politics.
That’s been really hard lately as I’ve watched my colleague Sen. Tommy Tuberville single-handedly hold up the promotions in our military because he’s mad at President Biden.
Why is he mad? Because after SCOTUS overturned _Roe_ , President Biden announced the military would provide leave and pay for the travel costs for any woman in uniform needing reproductive care not available in the state where the military stationed her. Sen. Tuberville says he is stopping promotions until this policy is reversed.
_[**Can you sign your name and tell Sen. Tuberville to stop putting politics ahead of national security?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67101074/418588428/-629832227?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk856-su-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWNmNmVlOC1lYzJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XauPRBCIKPfiPoi4ZtW4TvoJ1QI8RnkqNxpG26yrxvc=&emci=70959f9a-0b2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=69cf6ee8-ec2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=21278485)_
With over 250 promotions stalled and critical positions going vacant – including the Marine Corps’ highest-ranking officer who is also a member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff – Sen. Tuberville is putting our national security at risk. Military leaders are already reporting an impact on retention and recruitment for our all-volunteer military.
My colleagues and I have tried to talk to him, but he won’t budge on this. And so, I’m coming to supporters like you.
**[_Please, can you sign your name and tell Sen. Tuberville to stop putting politics ahead of national security? With new threats every day, we can't afford to keep our best from performing the work they need to do._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67101077/418588434/-629832227?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk856-su-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWNmNmVlOC1lYzJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XauPRBCIKPfiPoi4ZtW4TvoJ1QI8RnkqNxpG26yrxvc=&emci=70959f9a-0b2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=69cf6ee8-ec2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=21278485)**
It’s critical to our security that we stop this holdup as soon as possible, so I’m counting on your urgent feedback.
There’s work to be done,
Chrissy

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party. Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It has been a privilege to work to reduce hunger in CT and everywhere. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67102487/418596176/-1295403277?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzliYzExYS1mMTJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXALC-Iirxr7UBjYKLt9KaapYqKGmL31lVDioQ-YcQk=&emci=5ffaf6bc-0c2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=c39bc11a-f12b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=15529135) | Did you hear about all the work I have done to support farmers and reduce hunger recently? Earlier this month, my colleague Congresswoman Nikema Williams and I are building on our work to combat hunger and food insecurity through the Higher Education Hunger Through the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (OHH Snap) Act. This act will make it easier for low-income college students with an EFC to participate in SNAP. College is a bridge to success and financial stability, so no one should have to struggle with food insecurity during their studies. About 10% of Connecticut residents use SNAP, and I am proud to uplift their voices and look into how we can use the Farm Bill to look at the ways food insecurity, education, and nutrition are connected. I invited the House Democratic Task Force on Nutrition and Agriculture to Connecticut to discuss these critical issues, and I look forward to working with them to shape our Farm Bill priorities. Food insecurity has always been a key issue for me, and I am proud of my work year after year to work towards a world in which NO American goes hungry. **[However, this work puts a target on my back. The House Republican campaign arm already has attack ads out against me. If you want to flip the House blue and keep working on the issues that really matter, consider chipping in so we can fight back and keep CT-05 blue!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67102488/418596177/974063209?refcode=E3474-20230726-NutritionTaskForce-SL-Other&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzliYzExYS1mMTJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXALC-Iirxr7UBjYKLt9KaapYqKGmL31lVDioQ-YcQk=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [$5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67102489/418596178/974063209?express_lane=true&refcode=E3474-20230726-NutritionTaskForce-EG-Other&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzliYzExYS1mMTJiLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dXALC-Iirxr7UBjYKLt9KaapYqKGmL31lVDioQ-YcQk=)

clean_body: It has been a privilege to work to reduce hunger in CT and everywhere. | | Did you hear about all the work I have done to support farmers and reduce hunger recently? Earlier this month, my colleague Congresswoman Nikema Williams and I are building on our work to combat hunger and food insecurity through the Higher Education Hunger Through the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (OHH Snap) Act. This act will make it easier for low-income college students with an EFC to participate in SNAP. College is a bridge to success and financial stability, so no one should have to struggle with food insecurity during their studies. About 10% of Connecticut residents use SNAP, and I am proud to uplift their voices and look into how we can use the Farm Bill to look at the ways food insecurity, education, and nutrition are connected. I invited the House Democratic Task Force on Nutrition and Agriculture to Connecticut to discuss these critical issues, and I look forward to working with them to shape our Farm Bill priorities. | | Peter,
---
| **I’m excited to announce that Federal Way City Council President, Former Federal Way Mayor and Former State Representative Linda Kochmar has endorsed my candidacy to serve Washingtonians in Congress! **

Linda has been acknowledged for her track record of listening to the people she represents with the Outstanding Legislator of the Year and Washington State Woman of Excellence, among others.

| **Linda shared the following statement:**

_"I am thrilled to endorse Carmen Goers for Congress in the 8th Congressional District. We need leaders in DC who will fight for our small businesses and for our military families. I know that Carmen will do both and will do them very well. As a commercial banker Carmen has discussed the challenges small businesses are facing. I know that she will work hard to cut taxes and to remove the regulations that are strangling the growth that is possible."_

**_I am deeply honored to receive Linda’s endorsement_. **Linda embodies the type of leadership that overcomes the hurdles of politics that has hampered our ability to confront our problems with integrity and tenacity.

**The facts speak for themselves:** crime, drug addiction and homelessness are escalating out of control at the same rate that gas prices and taxes are burdening families as they attempt to mitigate our economic circumstances while raising children.

I want to serve Washingtonians in putting the brakes on Big Government’s addiction to stifling innovation, ingenuity and grit by putting burdensome overregulation and taxation in check!

Friend, My congressional district has some of the worst air quality in the world, due to an extreme concentration of corporate polluters that profit off of poisoning our air and water. Because of this, Metro Detroit has some of the highest asthma rates in the country. Within Detroit, Black people are three times likelier to be hospitalized from asthma than white people. **This is environmental racism. And it’s getting worse: asthma rates are on the rise.** **That’s why the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center’s work is so urgent.** The nonprofit organization is taking on environmental injustice in Michigan, working with communities of color and low-income communities to stop dangerous air and water pollution. By providing no-cost or low-cost legal services, they help nonprofit organizations and individuals that otherwise may not be able to afford to hire an environmental lawyer. [**Can you chip in now to support the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center’s work to protect disenfranchised communities from toxic pollution? I grew up thinking it was normal that I couldn’t play outside on some days because it was too polluted. But it’s not normal. Where pollution occurs is a policy choice, and it’s environmental racism.
As a voice for a district with frontline communities facing environmental racism, I advocate for policy solutions, like removing lead from all contaminated pipes and changing the EPA’s permitting process for polluting projects in order to put people’s health first.
I also work alongside grassroots movements, and I know that we need leaders at all levels making the changes our communities deserve. That’s why I’m supporting the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center and their fight to hold corporate polluters and government agencies accountable for environmental injustices.

clean_body: Taking on environmental injustice in Michigan with frontline communities. | | | Friend, My congressional district has some of the worst air quality in the world, due to an extreme concentration of corporate polluters that profit off of poisoning our air and water. Because of this, Metro Detroit has some of the highest asthma rates in the country. Within Detroit, Black people are three times likelier to be hospitalized from asthma than white people. This is environmental racism. And it’s getting worse: asthma rates are on the rise. That’s why the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center’s work is so urgent. The nonprofit organization is taking on environmental injustice in Michigan, working with communities of color and low-income communities to stop dangerous air and water pollution. By providing no-cost or low-cost legal services, they help nonprofit organizations and individuals that otherwise may not be able to afford to hire an environmental lawyer. | I grew up thinking it was normal that I couldn’t play outside on some days because it was too polluted. But it’s not normal. Where pollution occurs is a policy choice, and it’s environmental racism. As a voice for a district with frontline communities facing environmental racism, I advocate for policy solutions, like removing lead from all contaminated pipes and changing the EPA’s permitting process for polluting projects in order to put people’s health first. I also work alongside grassroots movements, and I know that we need leaders at all levels making the changes our communities deserve. That’s why I’m supporting the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center and their fight to hold corporate polluters and government agencies accountable for environmental injustices. subject: Notes From Tom

body:
Dear friends,In 2024, all of us who care about democracy in America will be working to elect national leaders who share our ideals.

But in November 2023, with no presidential, Congressional, or gubernatorial races on the ballot, I believe that the most important elections in America will be for school board.

Consider that this month, most of the Republican candidates trying to defeat President Biden attended the national conference of Moms For Liberty, the Hitler-quoting right wing group demanding the removal of books from classrooms and school libraries. Ron DeSantis promised the group that he'll impose his Florida school censorship policies on the country if he’s elected President; Donald Trump said he’d support subjecting all school principals to annual partisan elections. Moms For Liberty now has a well-funded national political action committee to elect school board members and superintendents who agree with these goals.

Why is the MAGA right investing so much in school board culture wars?

I think one reason is that they are genuinely threatened by our public schools' mission to teach kids objective facts about history and science, and to encourage critical thinking and debate. It makes sense. After all, if your political movement believes that Donald Trump won the 2020 election, that climate change is a hoax, and that vaccines are dangerous . . . if you believe in twisting truth to serve your leaders rather than forcing your leaders to tell the truth, then of course you’re going to want to change how our public schools are run.

But these MAGA leaders are also making a more immediate political judgement. If they can scare people into believing their despicable lies about teachers indoctrinating and sexually grooming children, they can turn those people out to vote — and use school elections to drive turnout that will also help their candidates for higher political offices. They are even trying to use fear about what’s being taught in schools to frighten immigrant and minority communities that might otherwise never have dreamed of voting for MAGA-aligned candidates.

Here is the good news: polls show that an overwhelming majority of Americans, including a majority of Republicans, oppose book bans, once they realize that this is what the culture warriors are doing. That’s right, most Americans believe that denying kids the right to read books about the Holocaust, and the heroes of the Civil Rights movement, and the existence of gay families is creepy and wrong. Most Americans trust librarians more than they trust politicians!

So here’s the bottom line: if we give MAGA activists and donors an uncontested path to win school board races in 2023, our kids will suffer and their movement will gain political momentum for 2024. But if we organize around ideals that are already hugely popular with the American people, then non-partisan candidates who support our public schools will win those races. We will thus protect our kids, and disrupt a major part of the extreme right’s political strategy.

Defending the freedom to read and to learn is a powerful, positive message in American politics today. That’s why I started Districts for Democracy, one of the only efforts in our country focused on electing school board candidates who believe in freedom of expression. I believe that we can’t wait till 2024 — we have to win this fight now. I hope you’ll join us.

Thank you,

Tom
Districts for Democracy will work one school board, legislative, and congressional district at a time to recruit and support candidates committed to freedom of inquiry, thought, and speech for everyone. We want to keep the culture wars out of our schools, return school board elections to their nonpartisan roots, and keep our schools and universities focused on their central mission: helping our kids become educated and engaged citizens of these United States.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Peter Willis,

We can’t let that happen, and it’s going to take organized grassroots activism to overcome the deep pockets and ruthless tactics of his corporate overlords. Can you chip in to our Climate Action Fund ASAP?? Give now and we’ll send you our “Stay Cool, Stop Fossil Fuels” drink koozie. body:

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The GOP is trying to strip away life-saving Endangered Species Protections for precious grizzly bears!** [**Take action now >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1897829?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) Imagine you are roaming along the open grounds of Yellowstone National Park. You’re a grizzly bear in search of food to bring back to the den for you and your cubs. The wilderness is your home, and these are your native lands. You don’t have any concept of state lines or the politics that go into “protected” boundaries. You happen to unknowingly wander just off of Yellowstone property having no idea that outside the park, vicious trophy hunters are waiting to viciously slaughter you. Suddenly in an instant, you are pierced with a series of painful bullets that rip through your thick fur -- **you feel nothing but agony as your last moments on this Earth come to an end.** Recently, the **bloody carcass of a mangled grizzly bear** , who likely suffered a similar horrific fate, was discovered _**just 14 miles**_ outside of Yellowstone -- in a location where grizzlies are at **HIGH RISK** of _Endangered Species Act rollbacks_ by GOP lawmakers and hunting lobbyists. [**Friend, with grizzly protections on the chopping block right now, it’s a CRUCIAL time to stand up and defend these helpless animals from brutal trophy hunters. Will you take action immediately?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1897830?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1897831?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
While this most recent grizzly death happens to come at a time when political tensions around ESA protections are heightened, it’s sadly not unusual for these iconic mammals to be **VIOLENTLY SLAUGHTERED.**
_**Trophy hunters are absolutely ruthless and show NO MERCY when it comes to getting their kill.**_ They will indiscriminately fire away at harmless grizzly bears, including mama bears searching for food to bring back to their helpless cubs. These innocent babies will likely **die of starvation or hypothermia** if their mama doesn’t make it back.
We cannot let the special interests of corrupt politicians and the hunting lobby seal the fate of these beloved mammals. We must **END** these senseless acts of animal cruelty and **STOP** the inhumane slaying of innocent grizzly bears NOW before this iconic animal is _**WIPED OUT.**_ [**But if we’re going to get the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service to protect grizzly bears from vicious trophy hunters, we need you to step up today. Will you use your voice to defend our precious grizzly bears before we run out of time?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1897832?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

You’re a grizzly bear in search of food to bring back to the den for you and your cubs. The wilderness is your home, and these are your native lands. You don’t have any concept of state lines or the politics that go into “protected” boundaries. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=27156%2E3422442%2E4tNNOI)
Derek, I don’t “do Congress” like most of my colleagues.
* I don’t take money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil, Big Pharma, or Wall Street Banks. **I’m the only person in the race who can say this**.
* I’m leading the fight to ban Members of Congress and their families from trading stocks.
* When Congress brought back earmarks (which are a way of funding Members’ pet projects) in 2021, I was the only Democrat to oppose them.
* When I’m home in Orange County, my toughest constituents are my three kids. Seriously, they track the bills we vote on and come prepared with the tough (but fair) questions.

name: Team AOC
subject: How many private jets do these CEOs need?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Workers are striking across the country.
#
We have workers all across the country either currently on strike or gearing up to strike, because we are all confronting the same challenge: **an unacceptable, unprecedented concentration of wealth and corporate greed in America.**
For real, how many private jets do these CEOs need?
We know that the way to make change is to stand together and demand more — and give the people in charge a reality check. When CEOs leave the job, life goes on. When workers leave the job, everything grinds to a halt and the money train ends.
[We've already been on the picket lines, and we're going to continue showing up to demand dignity for the working people of this country. Can you help us help them by making a $5 contribution today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230726.3VuUR8&refcode=em20230726-4699-P_FND_EGR_GOL&t=1&akid=4699%2E2526796%2EbdhBkr)
**[Contribute](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230726.3VuUR8&refcode=em20230726-4699-P_FND_EGR_GOL&t=2&akid=4699%2E2526796%2EbdhBkr)**
How can any CEO say, ‘I need another $100 million before my workers can have healthcare?’
This greed is insatiable. It is unacceptable.
We are in a fight against the endless pursuit of _more wealth_ , and the only way that we will win is by showing them that **our solidarity is stronger than their greed.** That our care for one another will overcome their endless desire for more. Always and forever. That’s what this is about.
[This summer, solidarity is what will win dignity for the workers coming together to demand more for themselves and their families. Can you chip in $5 to power Alexandria’s fight to help working people today? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230726.3VuUR8&refcode=em20230726-4699-P_FND_EGR_GOL&t=3&akid=4699%2E2526796%2EbdhBkr)

In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:
I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24b058d8998a473d8f6becbe3397d6df&_e=wA8gibeoS1rSZOfoWBXo-Bw8ai4nHJwRtHS0NUfbws8oR9RuFhfskYi88YSImKRkgmtpeilxyVJkgMbsfcc1MoEytudbMbWzoY26b7Iqctnx1n_3DIpFZrnz0onyEUZeRLM5MpCcHO_G6r0DL7QfZNB0ErnVnOvK2FH0eGIv2akTrotdUp5ojLkXOwbNnl2QYJDzppiR-QsHrgGD7rad05E_3xpZKHfyDOABz1SBvPRpZB5rHNuBCXX-uX4bdITi)

Hello Friend,

I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

I have always loved my country.

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

When I started my investigation, I hadn't even met President Trump. **But this investigation changed my life forever ...**

_Trump did NOT collude with Russia_.

**My investigation discovered the FBI 's unlawful investigation. And what I found makes me believe that they did it _intentionall_ y to get rid of President Trump.**

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

Once I found the truth, that's when the spying began...

Since then, I knew I had to do everything to help American patriots by offering financial assistance to whistleblowers, veterans, patriots, and some families of Jan 6 detainees.

As a former federal prosecutor, I know that we need protection if we are going to expose corrupt government gangsters.

I set a goal to raise **$45,000** by the end of the week, and we're behind in reaching that goal.

[As a personal favor, will you donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount to support these freedom fighters? Click here to rush your support before the deadline >>>](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24b058d8998a473d8f6becbe3397d6df&_e=wA8gibeoS1rSZOfoWBXo-Bw8ai4nHJwRtHS0NUfbws8oR9RuFhfskYi88YSImKRkgmtpeilxyVJkgMbsfcc1MoEytudbMbWzoY26b7IqctmXolPhyZ2vNq0dDye3JA8piWuRd03LE37QWvVc3PlDliRHJi3QJuf4smD9oarK2HjHBdTDMebzyl99E5kdeQFhkKLtfcs1D84slJcsnNK0CgkylEf9u6g07qMxEe5I3Dbz_4-b3_jTg8zi_SVA-TLm)

Conservatives, America-First patriots, or anyone who believes that Americans are **innocent** until proven guilty must join together in this fight.

Some of the Jan 6 detainees have become victims of the abuses outlined above, and we cannot leave them in solitary confinement within the D.C. prison system.

**This two-tiered justice system is a complete sham and a mockery of our constitution.**

Due process has been destroyed.

**Friend, this is incredible: For the first time ever, the U.S. Women's National Soccer Team are playing in a World Cup where they'll be paid _equally_ with the men's team.**
This victory took years of advocacy and organizing from players, fans and elected officials like Sen. Gillibrand. But the fight for equal pay is far from over: **Women still make only 82 cents for every dollar earned by a man.** This number hasn't risen in more than two decades — and the disparities are even more severe amongst Black and Hispanic women.
After celebrating the USWNT's win, Sen. Gillibrand is continuing the fight for equal pay for all women. She just introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment, which would make gender-based discrimination _unconstitutional_.
The USWNT's bravery and bold leadership proved that it IS possible to win equal pay for equal work. **But their journey also showed us just how difficult this work is, and how important it is for every single one of us to make our voices heard.**

clean_body: | | | Friend, as the Women's World Cup begins, Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand is calling for an end to gender-based pay discrimination. | | Friend, this is incredible: For the first time ever, the U.S. Women's National Soccer Team are playing in a World Cup where they'll be paid equally with the men's team. This victory took years of advocacy and organizing from players, fans and elected officials like Sen. Gillibrand. But the fight for equal pay is far from over: Women still make only 82 cents for every dollar earned by a man. This number hasn't risen in more than two decades — and the disparities are even more severe amongst Black and Hispanic women. After celebrating the USWNT's win, Sen. Gillibrand is continuing the fight for equal pay for all women. She just introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment, which would make gender-based discrimination unconstitutional. The USWNT's bravery and bold leadership proved that it IS possible to win equal pay for equal work. But their journey also showed us just how difficult this work is, and how important it is for every single one of us to make our voices heard. | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

| **The momentum is on our side! **

Recent reports indicate that Democrat fundraising is losing steam in the United States. This presents a keen opportunity for us to promote our values and strengthen the Republican Party's position.

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Hey friends, I hope you’re having a great summer so far. I can’t believe how fast it’s going - August is less than a week away!
As fall draws nearer, the election cycle will begin to heat up. And with it, my re-election campaign will need to buckle down and focus on our budget, our plans, and our fundraising efforts in order to win in 2024 and help Democrats retake the House.
Before we get there, let’s just take a minute to catch up. Here’s what I’ve been up to this month:
I kicked things off at one of my favorite spots, the Mission Valley Farmers’ Market, and then had a blast with Team SJ at the Scripps Ranch 4th of July Parade on Independence Day!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/43646A77535A5552633338564576557743444341777341794D476B386454307A7A4446723078385A6B53563767555867354F2F5A79586E6633543055534A4B41/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202023-07-20%20at%2010.12.50%20AM.png]
I had a great time playing in the annual Congressional Women’s Softball Game. Like in the halls of Congress, the press (our opposing team!) gave us a bit of a beating - but all in good fun and in support of a good cause.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/43646A77535A5552633338564576557743444341777341794D476B386454307A7A4446723078385A6B53563767555867354F2F5A79586E6633543055534A4B41/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202023-07-20%20at%2010.12.58%20AM.png]
In the middle of the month I joined thousands of San Diegans to celebrate the LGBTQ+ community at our Pride parade, and had the best day.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/43646A77535A5552633338564576557743444341777341794D476B386454307A7A4446723078385A6B53563767555867354F2F5A79586E6633543055534A4B41/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202023-07-20%20at%2010.13.09%20AM.png]
And of course, I kept up with my work in the Capitol, including our ongoing battle to pass a defense bill that doesn’t include a host of Republican wish list items at the expense of our service members. (You can watch me share my thoughts here.)
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/43646A77535A5552633338564576557743444341777341794D476B386454307A7A4446723078385A6B53563767555867354F2F5A79586E6633543055534A4B41/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202023-07-20%20at%2010.13.15%20AM.png]
As always, I’m so grateful to have a great team around me as I do this work - your support, advice, and insights make everything I do possible.
If you’d like to help my team get ahead of our upcoming fundraising needs, I would really appreciate any amount you’re able to give. We’ll be starting a big push soon to build up the resources my re-election campaign will need, so click here if you can pitch in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much.
-Sara
Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Wealth inequality is an existential threat to our Democracy.
body:
#
Peter,
Wealth inequality is an existential threat to our Democracy.
Political scientists have found that the 400 richest Americans had 22,000 times the political power of the average citizen in the bottom 90% of wealth. That’s why Justice Democrats Summer Lee, Rashida Tlaib, and Jamaal Bowman just introduced the Oligarch Act, a tax on the wealthiest Americans.
There is absolutely no reason why our country should have people who have to choose between paying their bills or putting food on the table; especially when billionaires have private jets and super yachts — it’s immoral.
We’re angry, Peter. We’re living in an oligarchy and it’s not right or just or fair.
[**If you’re also angry, will you stand with Summer, Rashida, and Jamaal in calling for a tax for the wealthiest Americans by making a grassroots contribution right now so that we can get more leaders elected who’ll stand up to billionaires?**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136145?refcode=em20230726-30079&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=30079%2E1203867%2ES0dd7E)
**[Donate $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136145?refcode=em20230726-30079&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=30079%2E1203867%2ES0dd7E)**
We’re working every single day to elect more bartenders, principals, community organizers and regular people to fight for the 99%, not the wealthiest amongst us.
When thousands of people pitch in because they believe in the issues we’re fighting for, we can take on the establishment that only serves corporate interests.
Thank you for taking action today,
Team JD
**[Donate](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136145?refcode=em20230726-30079&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=30079%2E1203867%2ES0dd7E)**
Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=30079%2E1203867%2ES0dd7E) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=30079%2E1203867%2ES0dd7E) and your state public health department.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

clean_body: We’re doing the work now to elect a wave of voting rights and abortion rights champions in the next election cycle. | | | | | A little over a year since Roe v. Wade was overturned, we’ve seen an influx of abortion bans and restrictions across the country. Abortion is now severely restricted or outright banned in 15 states — leaving pregnant people without options, forcing them to travel hundreds of miles out of state to access abortion care, and in some cases, putting their lives at risk. Many of the extremists pushing anti-abortion legislation are the same ones attacking voting rights, too — advancing their unpopular agenda by restricting our voices. There’s no question that abortion rights and voting rights are inextricably linked. In some states, the future of abortion access is directly on the ballot — like in Kansas and Michigan last year, and in the Ohio special election less than two weeks from now. At Fair Fight, we organize because free and fair elections are crucial in order to elect leaders who will defend reproductive freedom, look out for our communities, and support our right to vote. Let’s show that our efforts to defend abortion rights have stronger support than extremists’ efforts to take away our bodily autonomy. body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Last week - just one day after Governor Whitmer signed our legislation to expand early voting and other pro-voter policies, Michigan became the first state in the nation to file felony charges against those involved in the “fake elector scheme” in 2020.
These indictments are a crucial part of the ongoing effort to seek justice for the wrongs of the past - namely the unprecedented, nationally coordinated effort to falsify our state’s electoral college votes with the goal of undoing the legitimate results of the 2020 presidential election.
And as we begin preparing for the 2024 presidential election, they are also a reminder of our enduring work to defend democracy - and the challenges we must confront together if we are to ensure America’s one person, one vote promise is a reality for every citizen.
When I launched my campaign for Secretary of State in 2017, I knew we had a massive challenge ahead of us. I also knew that I couldn’t do it alone. Since then, you’ve made massive wins for democracy possible. We truly have a growing movement, and with more work to do ahead of us, it’s time for us to take the next step for democracy.
That’s why I am launching the Michigan Legacy PAC: to preserve the pro-democracy work we’ve done together and expand and fortify it in the years ahead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=072623]
Because here’s what I’ve learned as Michigan’s chief election official these last five years: we are in the midst of a serious, coordinated, multifaceted effort to weaken democracy. And when we fight back together, we win - democracy prevails and grows and becomes more healthier and robust than ever before.
Our charge is to keep working and fighting together to ensure we build the infrastructure necessary to win the battle for our democracy - electing pro-democracy candidates up and down the ticket, enacting pro-voter policies and supporting the clerks who implement them, and educating every citizen about their rights and options to vote in our state.
That is the goal of the Michigan Legacy PAC: to ensure we defend democracy, together.
If we want to succeed in 2024 and beyond – without having to rebuild from scratch over and over again for every election – we need to channel our energy and time into a sustained commitment to democracy and pro-democratic candidates. That’s what the Michigan Legacy PAC will do: build on the work we’ve done to safeguard democracy and create a true pro-democracy legacy in Michigan.
I hope you can sign up today to continue the work we’ve started together and be a part of our work as a democracy defender and support the Michigan Legacy PAC. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=072623]
Let’s keep leading, defending, and winning. Together.
Onward,
Jocelyn
PS: I know you understand the work ahead of us. You’re part of our growing movement already. But to take on the challenges that lie ahead, we need the help of everyone who is concerned about the future of our democracy. Can you please forward this email to one or two friends who you think would be interested in joining you as a Democracy Defender?

body:
We both got to Washington this year thanks to a people-powered movement.
#
Derek,
My friend (and North Braddock neighbor) Summer Lee and I are proud to both be from Western PA -- and fighting like hell for the working people of Pennsylvania down in DC.
With me in the Senate and Summer representing PA-12 in the House, we're advocating for the needs of our communities up on Capitol Hill-- like good jobs, abortion rights, and everything else that really matters to our constituents.
Another thing we have in common? We both got to Washington this year thanks to a people-powered team that isn't afraid to stand up to ultra-wealthy donors and right-wing special interests.
**[We'll only be able to stay in this fight with your help. So can you split a contribution between Summer Lee and our campaign today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230726-1?refcode=em20230726-1-8478&refcode2=8478_434096_0-q_kn&akid=8478%2E434096%2E0-q_kn)**

-- John ❤️

**BIDEN DOJ SUED OVER POLITICAL INVESTIGATION OF TRUMP’S ALLEGED TIES TO LIV GOLF**
_Trump Targeted Again by 2024 Political Rival_
(July 26, 2023) As if it is not enough for the Biden Department of Justice (“Biden DOJ”) to have brought criminal charges against former President Donald Trump, his political persecution continues in yet new form of what has widely has been reported as an investigation of his alleged ties to LIV Golf and the Saudi Public Investment Fund (“PIF”). This investigation, apparently implemented by the Antitrust and Criminal Divisions into Trump and his relationship with LIV Golf, his having made available his golf courses to host LIV Golf tournaments, appears to be an attempt to link the former president with foreign money, intended to deflect and push back from what any rationale observer knows is the Biden crime family’s accepting of millions of dollars of apparent bribes, laundered through Hunter Biden, from Communist China, Ukraine and Russia. To uncover the scandalous details behind this latest political hit on Trump, Freedom Watch filed Freedom of Information Act requests with the Biden DOJ, and when predictably the Biden DOJ failed to produce even one document, this pubic interest watchdog was forced to sue. The complaint with attached FOIA requests is embedded below and can be viewed at [www.freedomwatchusa.org](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=650f2cd592&e=8edd2b8f7d). The case is styled Freedom Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice, Antitrust Division et al, Civil Action No. 9:23-CV-81036-AMC (S.D. Florida). Larry Klayman, the founder of both Judicial Watch and now Freedom Watch, a former federal prosecutor who was on the Antitrust Division’s trial team that broke up of the AT&T monopoly during the Reagan administration, and who himself last year brought a class action antitrust suit over the PGA Tour’s attempt to monopolize the golf industry (See Klayman et. al v. PGA Tour et al, 50-2022-CA-006587, 15th Judicial Circuit Palm Beach County, Fl.), had this to say upon filing the complaint: “The Biden DOJ, which is more than highly partisan and has waged a literal crusade to destroy Donald Trump to prevent him from and being elected president again in 2024, knows no bounds. Coupled with its crusade to lock up the peaceful protesters of January 6, 2020, who supported Trump, it has been turned into a modern day Gestapo, along with its FBI.
For the good of all Americans and our nation, this illegal conduct must cease and Freedom Watch and I are dedicated to making sure it does. The Biden crime family can run but it cannot hide and must not be permitted to use a corrupt Biden DOJ to deflect and push back, for political purposes, on what any intelligent American now knows was and remains the Bidens’open handed bribery scheme to handsomely profit at the trough of foreign adversaries.”
**For more information contact Asher Anderson at Asher.andersonfw@gmail.com**
